hints.title: Within-Gender Row Ranking
hints.text: Assign a sequential rank to users within each gender ordered ascending by user_id.

hints.title: Gender Order Sequencing
hints.text: Map genders to explicit sequence numbers: female as 1, other as 2, male as 3.

hints.title: Interleaved Ordering
hints.text: Order the final results by within-gender rank first, then by the gender sequence number.

hints.title: Alternating Gender Ranking Query
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT user_id, gender
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, gender,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY user_id) AS rn,
         CASE gender WHEN 'female' THEN 1 WHEN 'other' THEN 2 WHEN 'male' THEN 3 END AS g_order
  FROM Genders
) t
ORDER BY rn, g_order;
```

complexity.time: O(n log n) window function partition and sort
variables: n: number of rows in Genders table
complexity.notes: Partitioned row number groups each gender independently before round-robin order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple order by cannot interleave rows without window ranks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory for row number evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses window functions to assign alternating positions across categories.
